pages.title: The Depot Lodge
pages.text:
The Depot Lodge
Scroll
In the mountains of Virginia, discover adventure & enjoy old-fashioned hospitality in
A Land that Time (almost) forgot
Welcome to the Depot Lodge!
The train depot dates back to 1909, when Paint Bank was the final stop of the Potts Valley Branch line of the Norfolk & Western Railway. This expansion was part of the mining boom of the early 1900’s. The Depot and our other historic buildings have been renovated and converted into charming lodging, while maintaining much of the original architecture.
Ready to come stay with us?
Make a reservation at any one of our gorgeous lodging areas.
Make a Reservation
Visit our other unique sights
Looking for a unique dining experience or to shop at an old fashioned general store? Paint Bank offers many attractions including hunting and fishing at Potts Creek Outfitters. Come see us!

pages.label: Lodging
pages.title: Lodging — The Depot Lodge
pages.text:
Lodging The Depot Lodge
Lodging
Main Lodge
A step back in time…Our 1909 restored train depot from 1909 offers modern lodging including a primary suite, a common sitting room and beautiful appointed rooms. The rustic décor delivers the feel of yesteryear.
View Lodge
Glamping
Glamorous Camping! We have three lavishly appointed Glamping tents that deliver unique lodging experiences for Campers who want amenities and luxury while they enjoy the Great Outdoors.
View Glamps
The Lemon Slice
Check out our newest venue, The Lemon Slice, a cozy cottage perfect for a pampered get-away, with all the essential amenities.
View Slice
Cabins
Our luxurious Cabin options are perfect for larger groups and families. The Pondersa and Fox Hill Camp offer multiple sleeping options with kitchen, dining, and living room space.
View Cabins
Caboose
A “railroad style” one room cozy experience, our authentic Norfolk & Western caboose is fully renovated, with private bath and patio for sitting and relaxing.
View Caboose
Airstream Trailer
Our genuine 26’ Airstream Trailer comfortably sleeps 4, with bath, TV and phone. A retractable canapé with bistro table and chairs adds to the retro experience.
View Airstream
Company House
Our two-story house is ideal for families. Featuring two twin bedrooms, queen primary bedroom, fully equipped kitchen and dining area, situated alongside the creek.
View House
Section Foreman's Cottage
Our 1910 renovated Section Foreman’s cottage offers cozy accommodations for 4, and is located right next door to the Main Lodge.
View Cottage
The Lemon Hotel
The Lemon Hotel, recently brought back to its original splendor, is the perfect escape to a bygone era with all the luxuries of today.
View Hotel
